contract_text: Soft structural governance may affect advisory context, telemetry, experimental routing preference and human explanation only. A soft observation, score, exposure flag or surface similarity cannot authorize an action, change truth or M/E status, widen a claim ceiling, establish Owner or epistemic acceptance, authorize an external side effect or release a safety gate.
escalation_rule: If a soft input is presented with an authority effect, fail closed and require the unchanged canonical hard gate; never convert the soft value into a substitute approval.
